verdict.rationale: Superset documents and exposes a real official MCP server (server-card.json, docs page, and a live hosted endpoint at api.superset.sh/mcp that responds with proper MCP OAuth handshake) allowing agents to create workspaces, launch sessions, manage tasks/automations, and control terminals programmatically. This is corroborated by runtime probes showing the endpoint live and speaking MCP/OAuth2.1, not just vendor claims. missing for 10: independent third-party/community usage report specifically of the MCP server (community evidence covers the app/CLI experience but not MCP integration hands-on), and no evidence of broader ecosystem adoption or client compatibility testing.
